reviewer.method: Read original sources and actual outputs; raise concrete defects; independently inspect repairs; run focused tests and negative probes; verify staged freeze.

scope: Whole-game forward design, source provenance/routing, task projections and planning/closure validators only

checks.evidence_and_reason: The current selector and entrypoints distinguish main baseline fd2, deep-audit baseline3fad, observed evidence cutoff2f46 and reported Build13 game source2654.152 exact source bindings and the new source note pass. Older Alfred launch instructions are explicitly historical; live head and owner must be resolved before gameplay changes.

checks.evidence_and_reason: All70 authentic task definitions remain byte-identical and receive current gap dispositions. The map preserves ten undefined requested IDs as SOURCE_NOT_FOUND. The requirement universe is explicit and does not assert that unknown future defects or implemented gameplay are complete.

checks.title: All seven pets really attack
checks.evidence_and_reason: All seven exact species retain named species-appropriate real attack, positive damage/contact, miss, interruption, recovery and recall requirements. Owl aerial combat is explicit; scouting cannot replace an attack and animals cannot use a human-tool fallback. The current evaluator and closure reject erased capabilities/profiles.

checks.evidence_and_reason: Species retain distinct attacks and useful specialties, friendly/hostile/loot identity, leash and target-loss behavior.Three field pets and two survivor escorts are selected design limits; local workers are separate. Rest is valid without eligible safe work. Unsuitable environments permit safe alternatives, with real combat retained across applicable progression.

checks.title: Survivor assistance and transaction integrity
checks.evidence_and_reason: All ten physical work families include mixed hauling, service, production, ordinary-cash purchases and every plot family including conveyors. CD03 selects unlimited logical mixed cargo like the player. Bounded jobs, approved budgets/reserves, revoked authority, changed prices, competing contributions and exactly-once custody are required; premium/real-money spending stays player-controlled.

checks.title: Readable stakes and viable recovery
checks.evidence_and_reason: Owned value is protected. Warned field danger can interrupt trips/work and temporarily disable actors or exposed operations. Recovery uses the last restored camp or initial safe anchor, restores playable player state and preserves cargo; care and owned-site damage restoration are free. Sanctuary attack exploits, reset loot, compounded shortage and repeat-failure recovery have explicit checks.

checks.title: Complete bounded resource/currency purpose
checks.evidence_and_reason: The22 decisions cover selected raw/product/currency/project/container roles and all33 render concepts exactly once through selected/alias/reserve dispositions. Ordinary cash custody is one currency; committed outflow is included so spending cannot reappear at the till. One premium currency, XP and permanent VIP retain distinct meanings. New sinks/recipes remain selected design with numeric balance unproved.

checks.title: Learnability, simple controls and readability
checks.evidence_and_reason: First-use, returning/resumed, denied and busy-camp states must explain next action, costs, danger and helper intent. Contextual movement/actions remain simple; T07 human-context scope is preserved and pet/job arbitration has proper owners. Landscape is selected explicitly, without inferring actual device behavior from a setting.

checks.title: Full behavior presentation
checks.evidence_and_reason: The plan covers applicable action/machine/transport start, work, contact, success, miss, empty/full/blocked, cancellation, recovery and transition states. Actual complete-cycle/multi-angle motion and audio listening remain mandatory. Regional contact C5 cannot be waived by false animation_delta or approved-clip reuse, while reused clips do not need to be recreated.

checks.title: Persistence, offline time and reconnection
checks.evidence_and_reason: Ten transaction boundaries specify precommit/commit/postcommit recovery. Ordinary simulation pauses in background; core play/recovery stays offline. Event participation requires verified connection and no offline event-input spending. Verified completion creates a durable claim that survives expiry and lost response; reconnect grants once. Migration/conflict/account isolation remain required.

checks.title: Accessibility and device behavior
checks.evidence_and_reason: Existing accessibility preferences and functional device obligations apply to the new loops. The16:9 fixture is corrected to1920x1080 and validated separately from20:9, while native tablet rounding is accepted. Landscape/fold/resume/quality/input and sustained native4K60 require real target-device evidence; new Build13 receipts explicitly leave physical testing unmeasured.

checks.title: Progression, regions and scope coherence
checks.evidence_and_reason: All100 authored outcomes preserve the original T12 identities, bands, owners, dependency keys and cadence. Late levels now produce useful world outcomes rather than QA-only chores. Main progression needs no deployed pet. Dry underwater routes, credible sky/terrain access, free returns and local-first transport avoid impossible actor assumptions and backward dependencies. Post-launch scope remains unchanged.

checks.title: Commerce, LiveOps and security
checks.evidence_and_reason: The selected single premium wallet, permanent VIP, explicit player purchases, free Level1–100 route and spend-blind challenge retain existing authority. Optional events cannot fix a compulsory base-game shortage. Feasibility, server time, durable earned claims, duplicate grants, refunds/restore, kill switch and rollback are connected to current jobs and economy.

checks.title: Diagnostics and release recovery
checks.evidence_and_reason: Existing minimal-purpose data, privacy/retention/redaction and GM isolation are preserved. Job, transfer, save, route and performance symptoms have owners while telemetry failure cannot govern play. Exact-source/signature/install/update/recovery and all final tests remain required; certification tasks route repairs to implementing owners.

checks.title: Honest decision closure
checks.evidence_and_reason: Twelve CD behavior choices explicitly supersede the five earlier open behavior decisions. Numeric tuning, native assets, exact producer receipts and actual runtime evidence stay open with task owners.
